rule: Zero-extra-hardware rule (proved for spaced wiring + interleaved modules, checked against the enumeration): with c = Q/(m N) coils per leg, coils of a leg m N slots apart and module j = legs {j + tN}, mode p is available with k_d = 1 iff c | p and m does not divide p/c; module power is constant (no 2nd-harmonic DC ripple in the series stack) iff also m does not divide 2p/c. A pole pair (p1, p2) works iff both satisfy it with the same wiring. Winding factor = pitch factor sin(p y pi/Q) x k_d. Other wirings (contiguous belts, matched triples) add modes with k_d < 1. Example: N = 16, m = 3, Q = 48 (c = 1): every p not divisible by 3 -> 8/4, 4/2, 16/8 yes; 6/x no.
